title: notifd rules.json
description: Structure of ~/.config/notifd/rules.json. The daemon is the authority on semantics (regex validity, zone references); this schema describes shape, types and ranges, for editors and forms. Unknown keys are ignored by the daemon but rejected here so typos are caught.

screen.description: Output name to show popups on (e.g. eDP-1). Empty = first screen.

defaultZone.description: Zone used when no rule sets one. Must be a key of `zones`.

defaultTimeout.description: Milliseconds a popup stays when the app did not ask for a time.

maxVisible.description: Popups shown per zone; extras queue. 0 = unlimited.

margin.description: Gap from the screen edge in pixels.

spacing.description: Gap between stacked popups in pixels.

allowCritical.description: Critical notifications still show during Do Not Disturb.

persist.description: Keep history across restarts (writes message text to disk).

defaultName.description: Sound-theme name played for every popup ('' = none).

fullscreen.description: Hold popups while a window is full screen.

screenShare.description: Hold popups while the screen is being shared.

opacity.description: Background opacity of the popup (text stays solid). 1 = solid.

fontFamily.description: Font for the popup text ('' = system font).

fontSize.description: Body text size in pixels (title +2, app line -1).

timerStyle.description: How a popup shows the time it has left: none, or any of line (a footer line that shortens), circle (a ring that empties) and frame (an outline that shrinks), separated by commas.

anchor.description: One of nine places on a 3x3 grid, or `free` (then set x and y).

x.description: `free` zones only: horizontal position, 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge.

y.description: `free` zones only: vertical position, 0 = top, 1 = bottom. In the lower half popups stack upward.

opacity.description: Background opacity of the popup (text stays solid). 1 = solid.

clickThrough.description: Clicks pass through the popup to the window underneath.

noFocus.description: The popup never takes keyboard focus (so it has no reply box).

fontFamily.description: Font for the popup text ('' = system font).

fontSize.description: Body text size in pixels (title +2, app line -1).

priority.description: How important: urgent passes Do Not Disturb and focus modes; high is marked. Default follows the app's urgency (critical = urgent).

media.description: Show large pictures and audio/video players in the popup (default true).

stack.description: Stack notifications of the same app/site/kind (or group) into one place with a count; click to expand.

timerStyle.description: How a popup shows the time it has left: none, or any of line (a footer line that shortens), circle (a ring that empties) and frame (an outline that shrinks), separated by commas.

rules.description: Checked top to bottom; for each of zone, timeout and silent the first matching rule that sets it wins.

match.description: Every listed field must match its regex (case-insensitive, JavaScript syntax). category = the app's category hint (email.arrived, im.received...); channel = app, portal or web; group = the group (zone id) the notification is in, decided by the rules that do not test the group (such a rule cannot set zone).

opacity.description: Background opacity of the popup (text stays solid). 1 = solid.

clickThrough.description: Clicks pass through the popup to the window underneath.

noFocus.description: The popup never takes keyboard focus (so it has no reply box).

fontFamily.description: Font for the popup text ('' = system font).

fontSize.description: Body text size in pixels (title +2, app line -1).

group.description: Notifications with the same group name (in one zone) are kept together under a heading.

priority.description: How important: urgent passes Do Not Disturb and focus modes; high is marked. Default follows the app's urgency (critical = urgent).

media.description: Show large pictures and audio/video players in the popup (default true).

stack.description: Stack notifications of the same app/site/kind (or group) into one place with a count; click to expand.

timerStyle.description: How a popup shows the time it has left: none, or any of line (a footer line that shortens), circle (a ring that empties) and frame (an outline that shrinks), separated by commas.

focus.description: Focus modes (like Apple's): while one is on, only notifications at or above minPriority, or matching an allow entry, are shown.

allow.description: Each entry is a set of patterns like a rule's match; a notification matching all of one entry always gets through.

chart.description: How the graph of a download or transfer popup is drawn by default.

center.description: The notification center: the list of recent notifications that the tray icon (or `notify center`) opens.

anchor.description: The corner it opens in; put it next to the system tray.
